reproducibilityCaveat: scripts/Dockerfile.capture installs from the semver ranges in package.json with no lockfile — package-lock.json does not exist until Phase 3 — so `git checkout 36845e99ea56e150f7a7d2d09dd7536b9b6bf3bb && docker build -f scripts/Dockerfile.capture . && docker run ...` resolves whatever satisfies those ranges at the time it is run, not necessarily the versions recorded in dependencyVersions. The versions above are the resolved set the capture actually ran against; pin them if an exact regeneration is ever required. Note also that MANIFEST.json is written by hand and is not produced by the harness, so it is expected to be the only extra file when diffing a fresh capture against test/golden/captured.
